name: autolens-assistant-al-chain-searches

Pairs with `al_run_slam_pipeline` (which is itself the canonical multi-stage chain) and `al_build_imaging_model`.

name: autolens-assistant-al-cluster-csv-api
description: Compose a cluster-scale strong lens model from CSV spreadsheets (`mass.csv`, `light.csv`, `point.csv`) instead of inline Python. Writes a runnable Python script in scripts/ that reads the CSVs and instantiates the model. **Status: stub.**

name: autolens-assistant-al-configure-search
description: Pick and tune a non-linear search for a lens-modelling fit. Defaults to Nautilus (nested sampling, the recommended choice); covers Dynesty, Emcee, Zeus, and the JAX multi-start gradient optimizers (MultiStartProdigy recommended when a fast MAP point estimate on a parametric source is wanted — not pixelized). Sets sampler-specific knobs (live points, walkers, tolerance) and the output `path_prefix` / `name` that determine where results land. Pairs with `al_run_search`, which actually calls `search.fit`.

name: autolens-assistant-al-custom-analysis
description: Subclass `al.AnalysisImaging` / `al.AnalysisInterferometer` / `al.AnalysisPoint` to add a custom likelihood term — kinematic constraints, external priors, joint probes (stellar dynamics + lensing), or any data that isn't natively a pixel grid or visibility set. The subclass overrides `log_likelihood_function(...)` (or a helper called from it). Combining whole datasets is a factor graph, not a subclass (see `al_multi_dataset`). Lighter than `al_custom_profile` (which extends the *model*); this extends the *fit*. Writes a runnable Python script in scripts/.

name: autolens-assistant-al-custom-profile
description: Write a new light or mass profile subclass for use in PyAutoGalaxy / PyAutoLens models. Walks the user through subclassing the right base class, implementing the required `image_2d_from`, `convergence_2d_from`, or `deflections_yx_2d_from` methods, registering parameter defaults / priors, and using the new profile in an `af.Model`. For *combining* existing profiles (bulge + disk, basis expansions) the standard `af.Model` composition already covers it — don't bootstrap a new profile if you only need composition.

name: autolens-assistant-al-datacube-modeling
description: Fit a strong-lens model to a 3D spectral datacube — typically ALMA / JVLA / NOEMA, where each frequency channel is a 2D visibility plane and the source's spatial morphology can change across channels (rotating disk, outflow, line-emission region). Reuses `al_build_interferometer_model` per channel but ties parameters across the cube. Pairs with `al_adaptive_pixelization` (Delaunay mesh is the standard datacube pixelisation). Writes a runnable Python script in scripts/. **Status: stub.**

name: autolens-assistant-al-debug-fit-failure
description: Diagnose a non-linear search that didn't converge, returned unphysical parameters, or produced an inversion that fitted noise rather than signal. Walks the canonical post-mortem checks — log inspection, residual maps, prior coverage, multimodality, inversion regularisation, position penalties — and proposes targeted fixes (tighten priors, switch search, add positions, increase live points). Use after `al_run_search` returns a result that looks wrong.

name: autolens-assistant-al-greeting-cosmos-web-ring

name: autolens-assistant-al-group-lensing

Pairs with `al_cluster_csv_api` (when N is large enough that inline Python composition becomes unwieldy). Writes a runnable Python script in scripts/. **Status: stub.**

name: autolens-assistant-al-hierarchical-inference

name: autolens-assistant-al-load-results

name: autolens-assistant-al-mge-decomposition
description: Build and fit a Multi-Gaussian Expansion (MGE) model for the lens light and/or the source — a basis of N Gaussians with tied or free centres / ellipticities, whose intensities are solved linearly inside the fit. name: autolens-assistant-al-run-slam-pipeline
description: Run a Source-Light-Mass (SLaM) pipeline — the canonical automated multi-stage lens-modelling workflow. Stages a parametric source fit, a pixelised source fit, a lens-light fit, and a total-mass fit, chaining priors between them. The right starting point for any production-quality lens model, especially with pixelised sources. Prereq: understand `al_chain_searches` and pixelisations.

name: autolens-assistant-al-sensitivity-mapping
description: Map the substructure-detection sensitivity of a strong lens by injecting synthetic subhaloes into simulated datasets matched to the user's data, fitting each with and without a subhalo, and measuring the Bayesian-evidence gain. Produces a (y, x, mass) map of "what could you have detected?" Calibrates non-detections from `al_subhalo_detect` and constrains the subhalo mass function. Writes a runnable Python script in scripts/. **Status: stub.**

name: autolens-assistant-al-setup-environment
description: Detect, install, and configure a Python environment for the PyAuto* lensing stack. First checks the active interpreter and distinguishes an absent, broken, or ready stack; then offers pip in a venv (the normal user path) or editable clones (contributors). Sets sandbox cache env vars and verifies imports. Use when PyAutoLens is unavailable, imports fail, or a new machine needs setup.

name: autolens-assistant-al-simulate-dataset
description: Synthesise a strong-lens imaging or interferometer dataset from a ground-truth Tracer (lens + source galaxies, redshifts, light + mass profiles). Writes data / noise / PSF FITS files plus a tracer.json to a dataset folder. Use when the user wants a controlled test dataset, a training sample for an ML pipeline, or a sanity check that a model can recover known inputs. For modelling an *existing* dataset see `al_prepare_imaging_data` instead.

name: autolens-assistant-al-subhalo-detect
description: Detect (or rule out) dark-matter subhaloes in a strong lens via Bayesian model comparison. Compares a base fit (smooth lens mass) against fits with an added perturbing subhalo at a grid of (y, x, mass) positions; the Bayesian evidence ratio is the detection statistic. Requires a converged base fit, typically with a pixelised source (subhalo signatures appear as small residuals only a flexible source can reveal). Pairs with `al_sensitivity_mapping` (what mass could you have detected?). Writes a runnable Python script in scripts/. **Status: stub.**

name: autolens-assistant-al-time-delay-cosmography
description: Measure H0 (or a Hubble-like time-delay distance) from a time-delay strong lens — quasar with measured delays between multiple images, or a lensed supernova. Builds on `al_point_source` (positions + delays) and `al_hierarchical_inference` (when joining several lenses into one H0 posterior). The headline observable is the **time-delay distance** D_dt, which scales inversely with H0 at fixed mass model. Writes a runnable Python script in scripts/. **Status: stub.**

name: autolens-assistant-al-to-notebook
description: Convert a generated narrative-docstring PyAutoLens script (.py) into a Jupyter notebook (.ipynb) — each top-level docstring becomes a markdown cell, the code between becomes code cells. Use when the user says "turn this into a notebook", "convert to ipynb", or wants a Jupyter/Colab version of a script the assistant produced.

name: autolens-assistant-al-update-wiki
description: Refresh wiki/ pages whose pinned source commits have moved, by re-reading the relevant source files from the PyAuto* repos and rewriting stale sections. Also surfaces newly added public APIs (new classes / functions in __init__.py) so the user can decide whether they warrant new wiki pages. Use whenever the user reports an API change, after pulling fresh source repos, or on a manual refresh cadence. Do NOT run opportunistically as part of unrelated work — the diff should be reviewable.

name: autolens-assistant-al-weak-lensing
description: Fit a shear catalogue with PyAutoLens's weak-lensing module — `al.WeakDataset` + `al.FitWeak`. Use when the observable is a per-source shear estimate (γ1, γ2) at a known sky position, not an extended-arc image. Lighter than strong lensing: no PSF, no inversion, no positions likelihood — just a residual model in shear space. Complements strong-lensing fits when the same cluster has both regimes. Writes a runnable Python script in scripts/. **Status: stub.**

name: autolens-assistant-contribute-upstream
description: Prepare a scoped update to autolens_assistant and propose it back upstream. Use this skill when the user says "contribute this back", "open a PR upstream", "suggest this to the assistant", or "send this to PyAutoLabs/autolens_assistant". It validates the git remote layout, confirms PR scope, creates or reuses a feature branch, stages only the intended files, commits with the repo's commit conventions, pushes either to the upstream repo (for collaborators) or the user's fork, and opens a draft PR against PyAutoLabs/autolens_assistant.

name: autolens-assistant-euclid-hpc-runs

Use when a Euclid lens sample outgrows the local machine; NOT for single interactive fits (euclid_setup_pipeline) or generic HPC concepts (wiki/core/operations/hpc.md).

name: autolens-assistant-euclid-model-lens

Use to choose and run the right Euclid pipeline stage for a science goal; NOT for setting up the repo (euclid_setup_pipeline) or hand-composed non-Euclid models (al_build_imaging_model / al_run_slam_pipeline).

Use when a Euclid lens's inputs need checking or building before modeling; NOT for HST/JWST/generic FITS preparation (al_prepare_imaging_data) and NOT for running fits (euclid_setup_pipeline / euclid_model_lens).

Use for any "model Euclid data" request that hasn't already got the pipeline running; NOT for general non-Euclid lens modeling (al_build_imaging_model) or for HST/JWST data preparation.

name: autolens-assistant-euclid-workflow-products

Use when a Euclid lens sample has been fitted and browsing output/ lens-by-lens has become tedious; NOT for inspecting a single fit (al_load_results / al_plot_fit_residuals) or for generic aggregator scripting (al_aggregator_bulk_analysis).

name: baa-ch02-designing-agent-systems

Covers scoping a first bounded workflow, model selection (size, modality, open vs proprietary, routing, VRAM), tools, memory, orchestration, speed/scale/reliability/cost trade-offs, single vs multiagent choice, evaluation and phased rollout. Use when starting an agent project, choosing or pricing models, deciding whether to go multiagent, or planning agent testing and production launch.

name: baa-ch03-ux-design-for-agentic-systems

Based on Chapter 3 of Michael Albada's "Building Applications with AI Agents". Use when designing or reviewing an agent's user-facing interaction, picking a modality, setting human-approval levels, writing error or clarification flows, or diagnosing low adoption or trust.

name: baa-ch04-tool-use
description: Guidance for designing, choosing, securing and operating the tools an AI agent calls, based on Chapter 4 ("Tool Use") of Michael Albada's "Building Applications with AI Agents" (O'Reilly, 2025). Covers local, API, plug-in and MCP tools, tool metadata, stateful-tool safety, agent-generated tools and tool-choice/fallback control. Use when defining or reviewing tool schemas, deciding where a tool should live, exposing a database or API to an agent, adopting MCP, letting an agent write code, or hardening tool-call failures.

name: baa-ch05-orchestration
description: Guidance for orchestrating AI agents, based on Chapter 5 of Michael Albada's "Building Applications with AI Agents". Covers agent archetypes (reflex, ReAct, planner-executor, query decomposition, reflection, deep research), standard/semantic/hierarchical tool selection, tool parametrization and execution, tool topologies (single, parallel, chain, graph) and context engineering. Use when choosing an agent type, picking tools from a large catalog, designing a chain or LangGraph-style graph, assembling per-step context, or evaluating planning approaches.

name: baa-ch06-knowledge-and-memory
description: Guides the design of agent knowledge and memory, based on Chapter 6 of Michael Albada's "Building Applications with AI Agents" (O'Reilly, 2025). Covers context-window budgeting, rolling FIFO windows, BM25 keyword memory, vector-store semantic memory, RAG, semantic experience memory, GraphRAG and knowledge-graph construction, long context vs retrieval, dynamic graphs, and self-notes. Use when choosing or debugging an agent's memory or retrieval layer, deciding whether GraphRAG is worth it, planning a context budget, or hardening a knowledge graph.

name: baa-ch07-learning-in-agentic-systems
description: Guidance for making agents improve from experience, based on Chapter 7 of Michael Albada's "Building Applications with AI Agents". Covers nonparametric learning (dynamic few-shot exemplars, Reflexion, ExpeL-style insight lists) and parametric learning (when to fine-tune, SFT for function calling, DPO, RLVR, small vs large models). Use when deciding whether an agent should learn at all, designing a feedback or memory loop, choosing between prompting and fine-tuning, preparing tool-call or preference datasets, or picking a model size to tune.

name: baa-ch08-from-one-agent-to-many
description: Guidance for deciding when to move from one agent to many, how to split responsibilities, which coordination pattern to use (democratic, manager, hierarchical, swarm, actor-critic, automated design/ADAS), and which communication, execution and state infrastructure fits (A2A, Kafka/Redis/NATS, Ray/Orleans/Akka, Temporal/Airflow). Based on Chapter 8 of Michael Albada's "Building Applications with AI Agents". Use when an agent has too many tools, when designing a supervisor or multiagent topology, when adding an agent, or when choosing brokers, actors, workflow engines or persistence for agents.

name: baa-ch09-validation-and-measurement
description: Evaluation and validation playbook for LLM agents, based on Chapter 9 of Michael Albada's "Building Applications with AI Agents". Covers hero scenarios and metric choice, structured eval cases and how to grow them, unit tests for tools, planning, memory and learning, end-to-end scoring (tool recall/precision, parameter accuracy, phrase recall, task success), consistency, coherence, hallucination, hostile inputs, and release gates. Use when designing an agent eval suite, scoring agent traces, debugging regressions, or deciding if an agent is ready to ship.

name: baa-ch10-monitoring-in-production

Use when instrumenting, observing, alerting on, rolling out or debugging deployed agents.

name: baa-ch11-improvement-loops
description: Designs feedback-driven improvement loops for production agent systems, based on Chapter 11 of Michael Albada's "Building Applications with AI Agents". Covers failure detection and root cause analysis, HITL escalation thresholds, prompt and tool refinement (DSPy, Trace, APO), backlog prioritization, shadow deployments, A/B tests, Bayesian Bandits, in-context adaptation and offline retraining. Use when an agent keeps failing in production, when planning how to validate or roll out a prompt/tool change, when sizing or reading an experiment, or when deciding how fixes should persist.

name: baa-ch12-protecting-agentic-systems

Use when designing, reviewing, threat-modeling, red-teaming, hardening or monitoring an agent, its tools, data flows or multiagent setup.

name: baa-ch13-human-agent-collaboration

description: bee-library 新增框架快取物件的完整跨檔流程，分兩類——Define 定義快取（來源是定義檔，經 IDefineAccess）與 Database 資料庫相依快取（來源是 DB，經 ICacheDataSourceProvider 自載 + cache-notify 失效）。含 ObjectCache vs KeyObjectCache 決策樹、ICacheContainer + CacheContainerService 兩處同步（漏補必 CS0535）、DI 相依環的延遲解析與 cache-notify 失效鏈。當使用者要「新增快取物件」、「加一個 cache」、「快取某定義 / 資料庫資料」、「KeyObjectCache / ObjectCache」、「cache-notify 失效」、「判權限/查設定要零 DB」之類需求時使用。

name: bee-add-form
description: 在一個已接好的 Bee.NET app 上「加一張表單」的多檔流程與避雷 —— 一張可用的 CRUD 表單 = 5 處純定義修改（FormSchema + FormLayout + TableSchema + DbCategorySettings 註冊 + ProgramSettings 上選單），不寫 UI / CRUD 程式碼。涵蓋 5 檔 checklist（漏哪個會有什麼徵兆）、business 表用 company scope、TableSchema 資料夾必須 = CategoryId、FormSchema 慣例（lookup 的 RelationProgId+RelationFieldMappings+ref_* RelationField、master-detail 的 sys_master_rowid、DropDownEdit+ListItems、計算欄 FormField.ReadOnly、sys_name 可省）、何時才需要自訂 BO。當使用者要「加一張表單 / 主檔 / 單據」、「新增一個 ProgId / 畫面」、「為某張表做 CRUD」、「Bee 表單要怎麼定義 lookup / 明細 / 下拉 / 唯讀欄」之類需求時使用，即使沒明講「加表單」也要主動觸發。

name: bee-app-scaffold
description: 在 bee-library（或畢業後的獨立 repo）搭一個「獨立 Bee.NET 後端應用/demo」的接線慣例 —— 不走 Bee.Samples.Shared，只依賴公開 Bee.* 套件或 ProjectReference。涵蓋最易踩錯的 DB scoping（CategoryId 是 common/company/log scope 選擇器、業務資料必須 company）、輕量 company context、自訂 auth（免 st_user）、seeder（DbCategorySettings 驅動建表 + sys_id 關連 seeding）、ProgramSettings 身兼 BO 綁定 + 選單來源、Server 不可依賴 Bee.Api.Client、以及反覆出現的操作避雷。當使用者要「起一個 Bee app / 後端」、「做一個會畢業到獨立 repo 的 demo」、「自己接 Bee 後端 host」、「設定 DatabaseSettings / DbCategorySettings / company 資料庫」、「Bee 的 common vs company 怎麼分」之類需求時使用，即使沒明講 scaffold 也要主動觸發。

name: bee-argue
description: For genuine forks — one dispatched worker per option argues that option's best case in parallel; the caller summarizes the cases and puts the choice to the keeper with a recommendation. Use when options are few, genuinely distinct, and worth the dispatch cost. Not for cheap forks or exploration.

name: bee-board-reader
description: Convert a BeeRef .bee moodboard into a readable report, labelled overview image, per-section contact sheets, and colour palettes. Use when a .bee file is shared or the user asks to read, review, or extract a moodboard.

name: bee-brainstorm
description: Design mode for BeeHarness. Use when the keeper deliberately opens design work — shaping a new project or feature, deciding how something should work, or shaping a project's SOUL. Not for implementation planning, code, or quick questions.

name: bee-cli
description: Access real-time context and life history from Bee, a wearable AI that captures and transcribes the owner's conversations. ALWAYS start with 'bee now' for the last 10 hours of conversations with full utterances - the highest-value context for relevant help. Use this skill when: (1) you need to know what's happening RIGHT NOW - recent conversations, current context, what was just discussed; (2) the user asks about something that just happened or someone they just talked to; (3) you need life context - who the owner is, relationships, work, preferences, places they go, photos; (4) searching pas…

name: bee-collect
description: Gather scattered ideas into organized GitHub issues. The bee collects pollen from every flower, checks if the hive already has it, and carefully deposits new work in the comb for later. Never edits code—only organizes the work ahead. Use when creating issues from TODOs or planning work.

name: bee-ds-design-guide
description: Use when making Bee-DS design decisions at the screen, section, or component level after the relevant Bee families are known or being compared. Trigger for requests such as 'design this in Bee-DS style', 'how should this Bee screen be structured', 'apply Bee spacing/layout rules', 'match Bee design language', 'choose between Bee variants', 'which Bee pattern fits this screen', or 'check whether this follows Bee-DS guidelines'. This skill is for design judgment, screen composition, spacing, states, and canonical Bee patterns rather than live Figma asset lookup.

name: bee-ds-live-lookup
description: Use when the task needs live Bee-DS lookup from Figma MCP: inspect Bee-DS Toolkit, inspect Bee-DS Icon Library, look up published Bee components, variants, tokens, icons, or verify the exact current Bee asset in Figma. Trigger for requests such as 'inspect Bee-DS in Figma', 'look up Bee tokens/icons', 'find the published Bee component/variant', 'check the exact Bee asset in the library', or 'load Bee-DS context from Figma MCP'. This skill is for live library discovery and exact asset verification, not for broader Bee design judgment.

name: bee-framework-review
description: 對 bee-library 框架做「全面體檢」的可重複方法論 —— 十一面向(架構分層、相依分層與循環相依、安全性、維護性、散落/不必要類別、序列化一致性、公開 API 表面、測試品質與覆蓋、文件漂移、效能/熱路徑、並行與全域狀態)唯讀審查,以平行子代理分面向掃描(非抽樣),交叉去重後彙整成分級(P0~P4)重構計畫 + 每項 10 分制評分。內建各面向的具體檢查清單、已知雷區、與「應為乾淨」的基準項(供回歸偵測)。當使用者要「框架全面體檢」、「架構體檢」、「架構健檢」、「框架健康度」、「framework review」、「全面 review」、「架構審查」、「幫框架打分/評分」、「有沒有散落或不必要的類別」、「提重構計畫」之類需求時使用,即使沒明講「體檢」也要在這類全框架審查請求時主動觸發。**對象是 `src/` 的框架程式碼**;若使用者要健檢的是 CLAUDE.md / rules / skills 這類設定檔語料,那是 `/dev-workflow:config-audit`,不是本 skill。**只負責唯讀審查、評分與產出重構計畫,不直接改 code**(修正另循一般流程)。

name: bee-handoff
description: Compacts a role's session into its handoff file so the same role can resume in a fresh context — working mode first, then task state, boot sequence, environment notes, and a fenced wake prompt for the keeper to paste; ends with a memory sync. Use when a role's context runs short or its session ends with work in flight. Picking a handoff up is bee-pickup-handoff's. Never a parking-lot sweep.

name: bee-harden
description: Use when the user runs /bee-harden or asks to harden, sharpen, or audit existing BEE articles. Selects the stalest articles from the audit ledger, runs the reader-first audit/revise/verify/sync workflow, lands results on a run branch, updates the ledger, and opens a PR.

name: bee-hindsight
description: After a phase or project wraps (or when the keeper asks), review how the work went and file concrete improvement suggestions to the suggestions inbox. Examines process, not code quality. Adds new files only — edits nothing.

name: bee-jsonrpc-backend
description: 用 Bee.NET 框架套件從零建立一個 JSON-RPC 後端 server(ASP.NET Core, POST /api)+ 前端 client 呼叫, 含 bootstrap、Define/ XML 設定、自訂 Business Object、demo 登入、session/API key、以及避雷。 當使用者要「用 Bee 框架建後端」「Bee JSON-RPC server」「AddBeeFramework 怎麼設」「Bee 的 BusinessObject / ProgramSettings / Define 設定」「Bee.Api.Client 怎麼呼叫 server」「Bee server 登入 / session / X-Api-Key」「把現有專案的後端接上 Bee」之類需求時使用,即使沒明確講出全部關鍵字也要主動 觸發。**只負責 server 建置 + client 呼叫的通用骨架與設定;不負責特定 app 的業務邏輯設計。**

name: bee-load-test
description: 用 tools/Bee.LoadTests 對 bee-library 框架跑壓測並判讀結果——前置檢查（容器、連線字串、prepare）、Local / Remote 兩種模式、以及「數字什麼時候不能信」的判讀紀律（參數過小、錯誤數被忽略、封閉模型的尾延遲盲點、Remote 量不到快取）。當使用者要「跑壓測」、「壓力測試」、「load test」、「量效能」、「效能測試」、「這樣改會不會變慢」、「量一下吞吐 / 延遲」之類需求時使用。**只負責執行與判讀，不負責調優**；也不為了讓數字好看而改參數或原始碼。

name: bee-loop
description: Executes an approved plan through implement → verify → review cycles, tracking states and escalating to the keeper when needed. Use only when explicitly directed ("run the bee-loop on <plan>"). Never infer loop entry from task size or type.

name: bee-pickup-handoff
description: Resumes a role from its handoff file — reads it whole, follows its boot sequence, re-reads law files changed since it was written, verifies state against the repo, and announces the resumed role and first move in the first reply. Use when waking into a role whose predecessor left a handoff (the keeper's wake prompt points here). Writing one is bee-handoff's; the pickup never re-interviews the keeper.

name: bee-plan
description: Writes executable plans for the bee-loop, from an approved design or a bounded task. Use when the keeper or project-orchestrator says to plan implementation work that the loop (or subagents) will execute. Not for personal quick planning (that's the global plan skill).

name: bee-plan-review
description: Reviews a written plan before the loop executes it — the gate between planning and implementation. Runs the mechanical core first (plan-checks.sh — target existence, block tagging, ephemeral prose, optional sandbox suite run), then judges six dimensions — accuracy, external reality, sandbox-run, ephemeral prose, determinism/AXI, no-globals boundary. Cold-dispatched; reports tiered findings and never fixes. Use before any plan is executed; finished work is bee-review's job, skill documents are bee-skill-review's.

name: bee-post-release-check
description: Use after a Bee release to verify the JS Team projects are up to date with it — swarm-cli quickstart and CI, bee-js supported Bee/API versions, bee-factory Docker images on Docker Hub, and the Bee OpenAPI version. Optional input is the Bee release tag; defaults to the latest stable release.

name: bee-project-update
description: Answers "where are we?" at one of three altitudes — design (compare the build against the target state), execution (on-track, blocked, starved), or a keeper digest (the gather in a few plain lines) — from one scripted gather, plus a mandatory hunt for aims not yet captured in the target state. Externally gated; the keeper asks any role for an update, or a role-file routing line fires. Not for working a task or writing records.

name: bee-relay
description: Carries context between roles as a final artifact — gated (keeper-passed) or ambient (shared surfaces). One topic per relay, self-contained, correctly sized; keeper-facing blocks are final — deltas arrive as standalone addenda.

name: bee-release-readiness
description: Use before a Bee release to find required changes in the JS Team projects (bee-js, swarm-cli, swarm-gateway, bee-factory). Compares Bee API specs, PRs, config flags and contracts between two Bee versions and produces a report with a human summary on top and Claude-ready implementation details below. Optional input is a Bee version range; defaults to latest stable tag..master.

name: bee-review
description: Quality review of finished, verified work — does the implementation match the plan's intent, what would a careful developer flag. Runs after bee-verify. Reports findings; never fixes. Not for reviewing plans (bee-plan-review does that).

name: bee-sample-add
description: 為 bee-library 加一個新的 samples/ 專案，內含前端類型選擇（Console / Blazor Server / Avalonia / WinForms）、後端配對決策樹（QuickStart.Server / in-process Local）、auth 需求判斷、`Bee.Samples.slnx` 整合、README 樣板與 ProjectReference 預設值。當使用者要「新增一個 sample」、「加一個 demo」、「為某個 src 套件做 demo」之類需求時使用。

name: bee-scaffold-from-formschema
description: bee-library 從一個 FormSchema XML 反推 / 產出對應的 FormLayout、TableSchema、雙語 LanguageResource 三類「sidecar」定義檔。涵蓋 throw-away xUnit fact idiom（直接呼叫 framework public generator 序列化原貌）、FormSchemaLocalizer sub-key 規範（Schema.DisplayName / Table.X.DisplayName / Field.X.Caption）、中→英欄位翻譯指引（sys_/ref_/audit_ 系統前綴 + ERP 慣用詞）、target 衝突偵測與處理。當使用者要「依 X.FormSchema 產 layout / language / tableschema」、「為 X 補 i18n」、「scaffold 一個 form 的 sidecar 定義」、「FormSchema 轉 layout / 翻 language / 反推 tableschema」之類需求時使用。

name: bee-serialization
description: bee-library 物件「三棲序列化」(XML / JSON / MessagePack)的設計指引。核心兩軸用途——XML 用於持久化(存檔 / 定義檔 / 快照 / 落 DB)、JSON + MessagePack 用於 API 傳遞(JSON-RPC 信封恆為 JSON；Encoded/Encrypted 的 body 由請求逐次宣告 codec，未宣告即 MessagePack)。涵蓋物件 recipe(無參數 ctor + XML/JSON 標籤，定義層不帶任何序列化套件標註)、集合(繼承 Bee.Base.Collections 基底 + 必到 WireContracts 顯式註冊 formatter)、wire 傳遞模式(物件本身 vs XML string)、行動端 AOT 型別形狀要件、踩雷與三棲 round-trip 測試樣板。當使用者要「物件要支援 XML/JSON/MessagePack」、「序列化」、「傳前端又要存檔」、「跨 wire 傳物件」、「KeyCollectionBase 集合序列化」、「新增 wire 型別」、「可序列化物件設計」之類需求時使用。

name: bee-skill-review
description: Design-quality review of a drafted or revised bee skill — the gate comprehension testing is not. Judges procedure soundness, scripts-first compliance, duplication, the three invariants (role-agnostic, ambient pickup, consistency with recorded decisions), and scope; reports tiered findings and never fixes. Use when a skill draft or revision needs quality review before anyone relies on it; cold-read comprehension testing is bee-skill-tester's job.

name: bee-skill-tester
description: Cold-reader comprehension tests for skill documents. Dispatches one cheap subagent per skill with a realistic scenario and asks how it would actually use the skill, then the parent fixes the gaps. Use when drafting or revising skills; not part of the bee-loop.

name: bee-skill-write
description: Drafts and revises bee skills — the artifact test (skill vs script vs role-file line vs glossary entry), house structure and front-matter registry conventions, the determinism split (judgment wrapped around a scripted core), and the draft → cold-test → review → sign-off lifecycle. Use when creating or substantially revising a skill; comprehension testing is bee-skill-tester's job, not this skill's.

name: bee-state
description: This skill should be used when updating workflow state in bee-state.local.md. Contains the full command reference for update-bee-state.sh including init, set, get, clear, all flags, and multi-line field syntax.

name: bee-verify
description: Runs the deterministic checks for a stage — build, tests, lint, file existence, output-vs-claim — and records the evidence that lets work move to the next state. Pass/fail facts only; quality judgment is bee-review's job.

name: bee:api-field-descriptions
description: Patterns for writing clear, consistent API field descriptions including types, constraints, examples, and edge cases.

name: bee:brainstorming
description: Socratic design refinement - transforms rough ideas into validated designs through structured questioning, alternative exploration, and incremental validation.

name: bee:condition-based-waiting
description: Flaky test fix pattern - replaces arbitrary timeouts with condition polling that waits for actual state changes.

name: bee:defense-in-depth
description: Multi-layer validation pattern - validates data at EVERY layer it passes through to make bugs structurally impossible, not just caught.

name: bee:delivery-status-tracking
description: Delivery status tracking and progress reporting. Analyzes repository against delivery roadmap to calculate actual vs planned progress, identify delays, and provide insights on velocity and risk trends.

name: bee:dependency-mapping
description: Cross-project dependency mapping and analysis skill for identifying, tracking, and managing dependencies across portfolio projects.

name: bee:dev-chaos-testing
description: Gate 7 of development cycle - ensures chaos tests exist using Toxiproxy to verify graceful degradation under connection loss, latency, and partitions.

name: bee:dev-cycle
description: Main orchestrator for the 8-gate development cycle system. Loads tasks/subtasks from PM team output and executes through implementation → unit testing → fuzz testing → property testing → integration testing (write) → chaos testing (write) → review → validation gates (Gates 0-7), with state persistence and metrics collection. Gates 4-5 (integration/chaos) write and update test code per unit but only execute tests at end of cycle (deferred execution).

name: bee:dev-cycle-frontend
description: Frontend development cycle orchestrator with 8 gates. Loads tasks from PM team output or backend handoff and executes through implementation → accessibility → unit testing → visual testing → E2E testing → performance testing → review → validation.

name: bee:dev-cycle-frontend-react-native
description: React Native frontend development cycle orchestrator with 8 gates. Loads tasks from PM team output or backend handoff and executes through implementation → accessibility → unit testing → visual testing → E2E testing → performance testing → review → validation.

name: bee:dev-cycle-frontend-vuejs
description: Vue.js/Nuxt 3 frontend development cycle orchestrator with 8 gates. Loads tasks from PM team output or backend handoff and executes through implementation → accessibility → unit testing → visual testing → E2E testing → performance testing → review → validation.

name: bee:dev-feedback-loop
description: Development cycle feedback system - calculates assertiveness scores, analyzes prompt quality for all agents executed, aggregates cycle metrics, performs root cause analysis on failures, and generates improvement reports to docs/feedbacks/cycle-{date}/.

name: bee:dev-frontend-accessibility
description: Gate 1 of frontend development cycle - ensures all components pass axe-core automated accessibility scans with zero WCAG 2.1 AA violations.

name: bee:dev-frontend-accessibility-react-native
description: Gate 1 of the React Native frontend development cycle - ensures all components pass accessibility checks with zero violations: correct accessibilityLabel, accessibilityRole, accessibilityHint, VoiceOver (iOS) and TalkBack (Android) compatibility, and minimum touch target sizes.

name: bee:dev-frontend-accessibility-vuejs
description: Gate 1 of the Vue.js frontend development cycle - ensures all components pass axe-core automated accessibility scans with zero WCAG 2.1 AA violations.

name: bee:dev-frontend-e2e
description: Gate 5 of frontend development cycle - ensures all user flows from product-designer have passing E2E tests with Playwright across browsers.

name: bee:dev-frontend-e2e-react-native
description: Gate 5 of the React Native frontend development cycle - ensures all user flows from product-designer have passing Detox E2E tests on both iOS (simulator) and Android (emulator/device).

name: bee:dev-frontend-e2e-vuejs
description: Gate 5 of the Vue.js frontend development cycle - ensures all user flows from product-designer have passing E2E tests with Playwright across browsers.

name: bee:dev-frontend-performance
description: Gate 6 of frontend development cycle - ensures Core Web Vitals compliance, Lighthouse performance score > 90, and bundle size within budget.

name: bee:dev-frontend-performance-react-native
description: Gate 6 of the React Native frontend development cycle - ensures JS bundle size within budget, Hermes engine enabled, FlatList/FlashList correctly used, image optimization applied, and no unnecessary re-renders detected. Covers React Native-specific optimizations including memo, useCallback, useMemo, and FlashList for performant list rendering.

name: bee:dev-frontend-performance-vuejs
description: Gate 6 of the Vue.js frontend development cycle - ensures Core Web Vitals compliance, Lighthouse performance score > 90, and bundle size within budget. Covers Nuxt 3-specific optimizations including useAsyncData, useLazyFetch, and NuxtImg.

name: bee:dev-frontend-visual
description: Gate 4 of frontend development cycle - ensures all components have snapshot tests covering all states, viewports, and edge cases.

name: bee:dev-frontend-visual-react-native
description: Gate 4 of the React Native frontend development cycle - ensures all components have Jest snapshot tests covering all states, both platforms (iOS and Android), and edge cases using React Native Testing Library renders.

name: bee:dev-frontend-visual-vuejs
description: Gate 4 of the Vue.js frontend development cycle - ensures all components have snapshot tests covering all states, viewports, and edge cases using Vitest snapshots.

name: bee:dev-fuzz-testing
description: Gate 4 of development cycle - ensures fuzz tests exist with proper seed corpus to discover edge cases, crashes, and unexpected input handling.

name: bee:dev-implementation
description: Gate 0 of the development cycle. Executes code implementation using the appropriate specialized agent based on task content and project language. Handles TDD workflow with RED-GREEN phases. Follows project standards defined in docs/PROJECT_RULES.md.

name: bee:dev-integration-testing
description: Gate 6 of development cycle - ensures integration tests pass for all external dependency interactions using real containers via Docker Compose + RefreshDatabase.

name: bee:dev-multi-tenant
description: Multi-tenant development cycle orchestrator following Bee Standards. Auto-detects the service stack (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, RabbitMQ, S3), then executes a gate-based implementation using tenantId from JWT for database-per-tenant isolation via stancl/tenancy or spatie/multitenancy packages (TenantManager, TenantService). MUST install and configure the tenancy package first; auth middleware depends on it. Both are required dependencies. Each gate dispatches bee:backend-engineer-php with context and section references. The agent loads multi-tenant.md via WebFetch and has all code examples.

name: bee:dev-property-testing
description: Gate 5 of development cycle - ensures property-based tests exist to verify domain invariants hold for all randomly generated inputs.

name: bee:dev-refactor
description: Analyzes backend codebase (PHP/Laravel) against standards and generates refactoring tasks for bee:dev-cycle. For frontend projects, use bee:dev-refactor-frontend instead.

name: bee:dev-refactor-frontend
description: Analyzes frontend codebase against Bee standards and generates refactoring tasks for bee:dev-cycle-frontend. Dispatches frontend-specific agents in ANALYSIS mode.

name: bee:dev-refactor-frontend-react-native
description: Analyzes React Native frontend codebase against Bee standards and generates refactoring tasks for bee:dev-cycle-frontend-react-native. Dispatches React Native-specific agents in ANALYSIS mode.

name: bee:dev-refactor-frontend-vuejs
description: Analyzes Vue.js/Nuxt 3 frontend codebase against Bee standards and generates refactoring tasks for bee:dev-cycle-frontend-vuejs. Dispatches Vue.js-specific agents in ANALYSIS mode.

name: bee:dev-unit-testing
description: Gate 1 of development cycle - ensures unit test coverage meets threshold (85%+) for all acceptance criteria using TDD methodology.

name: bee:dev-validation
description: Development cycle validation gate (Gate 5) - validates all acceptance criteria are met and requires explicit user approval before completion.

name: bee:dispatching-parallel-agents
description: Concurrent investigation pattern - dispatches multiple AI agents to investigate and fix independent problems simultaneously.

name: bee:documentation-review
description: Comprehensive checklist and process for reviewing documentation quality including voice, tone, structure, completeness, and technical accuracy.

name: bee:documentation-structure
description: Patterns for organizing and structuring documentation including hierarchy, navigation, and information architecture.

name: bee:executing-plans
description: Controlled plan execution with human review checkpoints - loads plan, executes in batches, pauses for feedback. Supports one-go (autonomous) or batch modes.

name: bee:executive-reporting
description: Executive communication and reporting skill for creating dashboards, status summaries, and board packages. Focuses on actionable insights for leadership.

name: bee:explore-codebase
description: Autonomous two-phase codebase exploration - first discovers natural perspectives (layers, components, boundaries), then dispatches adaptive deep-dive explorers based on what was discovered. Synthesizes findings into actionable insights.

name: bee:finishing-a-development-branch
description: Branch completion workflow - guides merge/PR/cleanup decisions after implementation is verified complete.

name: bee:interviewing-user
description: Proactive requirements gathering - systematically interviews the user to uncover ambiguities, preferences, and constraints BEFORE implementation begins.

name: bee:linting-codebase
description: Parallel lint fixing pattern - runs lint checks, groups issues into independent streams, and dispatches AI agents to fix all issues until the codebase is clean.

name: bee:opencode-review
description: External code review via OpenCode CLI - sends diff to a second AI model (e.g., Qwen3-Max, GPT-5-Nano) for independent review. Use after Bee's 6 parallel reviewers complete, as a complementary external perspective. Integrates with bee:requesting-code-review pipeline.

name: bee:portfolio-planning
description: Strategic portfolio planning skill for multi-project coordination, capacity assessment, and portfolio optimization. Provides framework for portfolio-level decision making.

name: bee:pre-dev-api-design
description: Gate 4: API contracts document - defines component interfaces and data contracts before protocol/technology selection. Large Track only.

name: bee:pre-dev-data-model
description: Gate 5: Data structures document - defines entities, relationships, and ownership before database technology selection. Large Track only.

name: bee:pre-dev-delivery-planning
description: Gate 9 (Full Track) / Gate 4 (Small Track): Delivery roadmap and timeline planning. Transforms tasks into realistic delivery schedule with critical path analysis, resource allocation, and delivery breakdown. MANDATORY gate for both workflows.

name: bee:pre-dev-dependency-map
description: Gate 6: Technology choices document - explicit, versioned, validated technology selections with justifications. Large Track only. HARD BLOCK: Must load Bee Standards and PROJECT_RULES.md before proceeding.

name: bee:pre-dev-design-validation

name: beluga-bouton-de-branche-d-une-tache

Covers the biological-versus-technical replication distinction (technical replicates do not add degrees of freedom for biological inference), replicate-number-versus-sequencing-depth budgeting, scRNA-seq sample-versus-cell allocation under a pseudobulk model, and the critique that "n=3" is a publication convention rather than a…

name: bio-experimental-design-validation-strategy
description: Designs validation logic for biological findings using orthogonal assays, replication strategy, controls, and failure criteria. Use when analysis results look promising and the next step is deciding how to validate, de-risk, or prioritize follow-up work.

name: bio-expert
description: The master orchestrator for ClawOmics. It acts as the domain-specific workflow layer between OpenClaw conversation logic and bioinformatics execution, producing structured planning artifacts, explicit agent state, and confirmation-gated run bootstraps.

name: bio-single-cell-scatac-analysis
description: Single-cell ATAC-seq analysis with Signac (R/Seurat) and ArchR. Process 10X Genomics scATAC data, perform QC, dimensionality reduction, clustering, peak calling, and motif activity scoring with chromVAR. Use when analyzing single-cell ATAC-seq data.

name: bio-single-cell-scatac-analysis
description: Analyze single-cell ATAC-seq with Signac/ArchR (R) and SnapATAC2 (Python alternative). Use when processing scATAC fragments, choosing a framework, calling consensus peaks, running TF-IDF/LSI while diagnosing the depth component, scoring chromVAR motif deviations against GC-matched backgrounds, detecting homotypic vs heterotypic doublets, or deciding whether to binarize the count matrix.

name: bio-single-cell-splicing
description: Analyzes alternative splicing at single-cell resolution using BRIE2 for probabilistic PSI estimation or leafcutter2 for cluster-based analysis with NMD detection. Identifies cell-type-specific splicing patterns. Use when analyzing isoform usage in scRNA-seq or finding splicing differences between cell populations.

name: bio-single-cell-splicing
description: Analyzes alternative splicing at single-cell resolution. The first decision is library chemistry — 10X 3' is fundamentally limited (RT primes from poly-A, R2 falls in 3' UTR, <0.1 junction read per cell per AS event). Plate-based full-length methods (Smart-seq3, FLASH-seq, VASA-seq, STORM-seq) and single-cell long-read (MAS-Iso-seq, scISOr-Seq2) are the chemistries that give per-cell isoform structure. Tools include MARVEL (R, Smart-seq integrated), BRIE2 (Bayesian PSI with regulatory features and ELBO_gain test), scQuint (junction-cluster, plate-based; not for 10X), SpliZ (annotation-free Z-…

name: bio-single-cell-splicing
description: Analyzes alternative splicing at single-cell resolution. Start by determining whether library chemistry supports the requested inference: 10X 3' is unsuitable for transcriptome-wide splicing; full-length plate and single-cell long-read assays support per-cell isoform structure. Routes work to MARVEL, BRIE2, scQuint, SpliZ, Psix, Sierra (APA), or replicate-aware pseudobulk.

name: bio-single-cell-trajectory-inference
description: Infer developmental trajectories and pseudotime from single-cell RNA-seq data using Monocle3, Slingshot, and scVelo for RNA velocity analysis. Use when inferring developmental trajectories or pseudotime.

name: bio-single-cell-trajectory-inference
description: Infers developmental trajectories, pseudotime, RNA velocity, and directed fate probabilities from single-cell data using PAGA, Slingshot, Monocle3, DPT, Palantir, scVelo, and CellRank 2. Use when ordering cells along a differentiation continuum, choosing a trajectory method by topology, rooting pseudotime, estimating RNA velocity direction, computing fate probabilities near a bifurcation, or judging whether an inferred trajectory is real.

name: bio-sketch
description: Use when generating an NIH or NSF Biographical Sketch in SciENcv (current format): personal statement, contribution statements (new 2025 NIH format), positions and honors, research support. Covers NIH vs NSF differences.

name: bio-small-rna-seq-mirge3-analysis

name: bio-small-rna-seq-smrna-preprocessing

name: bio-small-rna-seq-smrna-preprocessing
description: Preprocess small RNA sequencing data with adapter trimming and size selection optimized for miRNA, piRNA, and other small RNAs. Use when preparing small RNA-seq reads for downstream quantification or discovery analysis.

name: bio-small-rna-seq-target-prediction
description: Predicts and prioritizes miRNA target genes with seed-based tools (miRanda, TargetScan, miRDB) and experimentally validated databases (miRTarBase, multiMiR). Use when deciding that a predicted target is a hypothesis not a finding; ranking by the right score (weighted context++, mirSVR, miRDB); raising confidence by intersecting predictions with inversely-correlated mRNA DE; weighing validated (CLIP/reporter) over predicted evidence; or avoiding the circular enrichment of unfiltered target lists.

name: bio-small-rna-seq-target-prediction
description: Predict miRNA target genes using sequence-based algorithms and database lookups. Use when identifying potential mRNA targets of differentially expressed or functionally important miRNAs.

name: bio-small-rna-seq-trf-pirna-profiling

name: bio-spatial-transcriptomics-spatial-neighbors
description: Build spatial neighbor graphs for spatial transcriptomics data using Squidpy. Compute k-nearest neighbors, Delaunay triangulation, and radius-based connectivity for downstream spatial analyses. Use when building spatial neighborhood graphs.

name: bio-spatial-transcriptomics-spatial-preprocessing
description: Quality control, filtering, normalization, and feature selection for spatial transcriptomics data. Calculate QC metrics, filter spots/cells, normalize counts, and identify highly variable genes. Use when filtering and normalizing spatial transcriptomics data.

name: bio-spatial-transcriptomics-spatial-preprocessing

description: Compute spatial statistics for spatial transcriptomics data using Squidpy. Calculate Moran's I, Geary's C, spatial autocorrelation, co-occurrence analysis, and neighborhood enrichment. Use when computing spatial autocorrelation or co-occurrence statistics.

name: bizplan-document
description: 사업계획서를 제출용 완성본으로 끝까지 만드는 완성 문서 모드 스킬. 브리프(또는 빠른·꼼꼼 초안)를 받아 깊은 조사로 숫자를 채우고, 창업아이템 개요(요약) 양식 표부터 4장 팀 구성까지 전 절을 경어체 서술 문단·주제구·소주제의 완성 문서 서식으로 전체 분량을 쓴다. 절마다 시각자료(HTML 33종 --print)·표·사진 격자를 최대한 넣고, docx·hwpx(hwp)·pdf와 쪽 미리보기를 한 번에 만든 뒤 쪽마다 확인한다. 쪽 수는 줄이지 않고 공고 분량 대비만 보고한다. "완성본으로 만들어줘", "제출용으로 다 써줘", "그림까지 다 넣어서", "한글 파일이랑 PDF로 뽑아줘", "완성 문서", "최종본" 같은 요청에 사용한다. 막연한 시작 요청은 bizplan 라우터, 빠른 초안만 원하면 bizplan-quick, 수출바우처 계획서는 bizplan-export를 사용한다.

name: bizplan-export
description: 수출바우처 전용 스킬. 제품 현황·수출 필요성, 목표시장·고객군, 수출 마케팅 목표, 목표시장 상세 분석(시장 규모·수입 현황·현지 니즈·경쟁 차별화)을 만든다. "수출바우처", "해외 진출 계획", "목표시장 분석", "수출 전략", "진출 국가" 같은 요청에 사용한다.

name: bizplan-financial
description: You are the financial projection engine for `/bizplan financial <business-type>`. You produce detailed financial forecasts including a revenue model, monthly Year 1 P&L, 3-year summary projections, break-even analysis, and cash flow projections. This skill is invoked standalone or as the **bizplan-financial** subagent within `/bizplan analyze`.

name: bizplan-funding
description: You are the funding research engine for `/bizplan funding <business-type>`. You analyze all available funding and financing options for starting a specific business in the United States, from bootstrapping to SBA loans to angel investors. This helps the business owner understand how to fund their startup costs.

name: bizplan-growth
description: 성장 전략(Scale-up) 파트 전용 스킬. 비즈니스 모델·수익 모델(매출 산식), 시장 진입 퍼널, 협약 기간 매출·투자·고용 목표, 인과 로드맵(단·중·장기), SWOT, BM 구조도, 재무 추정을 만든다. "성장 전략 써줘", "비즈니스 모델", "BM 짜줘", "수익 모델", "마케팅 전략", "SWOT" 같은 요청에 사용한다.

name: bizplan-interview
description: 사업계획서를 쓰기 전에 사용자를 블록별로 심층 인터뷰해 모든 사실·근거·제약을 프로젝트 브리프(브리프.md) 한 파일에 고정하는 스킬. 이후 모든 모드는 긴 대화 맥락 대신 이 브리프를 읽고 작업하므로, 대화가 길어져 앞 내용을 놓치거나 섞는 문제를 줄이고 단계마다 새 대화로 이어갈 수 있다. 작업 방식(빠른·꼼꼼·완성 문서·섹션만)에 맞춰 인터뷰 깊이를 정하고, 채팅 인터뷰 또는 질문지 일괄 작성 중 고르게 한다. "인터뷰부터 해줘", "꼼꼼하게 물어봐줘", "처음부터 제대로 정리하자", "브리프 만들어줘", "질문지 줘", "내 상황부터 다 정리해줘" 같은 요청과, 라우터가 작성 시작 전에 이 단계로 보낼 때 사용한다.

name: bizplan-item
description: 막연한 창업 아이디어를 구체화해 아이템명·문제·솔루션·차별점·타겟의 뼈대를 잡는 첫 단계 스킬. "아이디어를 구체화해줘", "창업 아이템 정리", "아이템명 지어줘", "아이템 뼈대 잡아줘" 같은 요청에 사용한다. 지원사업 선택이나 전체 진행 방식이 정해지지 않은 막연한 요청은 bizplan 라우터를 먼저 사용한다.

name: bizplan-kstartup
description: K-Startup 표준양식 사업계획서 본문(.docx)을 만든다. 문제인식·실현가능성·성장전략·팀구성 순으로 채우고 표지·목차·본문·첨부 구조, 표와 그림 번호, 평가위원이 읽는 흐름을 규격대로 맞춘다. 예비창업패키지·초기창업패키지·청년창업사관학교 등에 제출할 문서가 필요할 때 고른다. 트리거: K-Startup 사업계획서, 예비창업패키지, 초기창업패키지, 청년창업사관학교, PSST 사업계획서, 창업 사업계획서, 사업계획서 본문. 사전 조사는 bizplan-research, 발표자료는 bizplan-kstartup-pitch를 쓴다.

name: bizplan-kstartup-pitch
description: 사업계획서 본문에서 발표용 피치덱(.pptx) 17장을 만든다. 본문 항목을 슬라이드로 옮기고 상황에 맞는 스토리라인(문제 먼저·성과 먼저·시장 먼저) 중 하나를 골라 순서를 잡은 뒤 발표 노트까지 낸다. 본문은 제출했고 데모데이·IR 발표가 남았을 때 고른다. 트리거: K-Startup 피치덱, 사업계획서 발표자료, 창업 피치덱, 데모데이 발표자료, 스타트업 IR, 심사발표 자료, 창업 PT. 본문은 bizplan-kstartup, 강의 슬라이드는 lecture-slides를 쓴다.

name: bizplan-licenses
description: You are the license research engine for `/bizplan licenses <business-type>`. You produce a comprehensive checklist of every license, permit, and certification needed to legally operate a specific business in the United States. This is the definitive "can I legally open my doors?" checklist.

name: bizplan-location
description: You are the location analysis engine for `/bizplan location <business-type> <state>`. You produce a deep dive into state-specific requirements, costs, tax environment, and business climate for operating a specific business in a given US state.

name: bizplan-marketing
description: You are the marketing strategy engine for `/bizplan marketing <business-type>`. You build a comprehensive go-to-market strategy for a new business, covering customer acquisition channels, budget allocation, launch strategy, and ongoing marketing tactics.

name: bizplan-outline
description: 사업계획서 본문을 쓰기 전에 대제목→중제목→소제목→한두 줄 요약까지 큰틀을 한눈에 잡는 스킬. 제출 양식이 있으면 양식 목차를, 없으면 PSST 기본 목차를 쓰고, 소제목마다 근거·증빙 슬롯(보유/필요)과 배점 비례 권장 분량을 붙여 이후 섹션 작성의 입력으로 넘긴다. "큰틀 잡아줘", "목차 먼저", "구조부터 보여줘", "아웃라인", "목차랑 요약만", "어떻게 구성할지" 같은 요청에 사용한다. 완성된 본문을 한 장으로 압축하는 개요 요약은 bizplan-summary가 담당한다.

name: bizplan-pitch
description: 발표(피칭) 준비 전용 스킬. 발표 흐름(스토리 아크), 슬라이드 구성안, 오프닝·클로징, 30초 답변, 심사위원 예상 질문·모범 답변을 만든다. "발표 준비", "피칭", "PT 준비", "발표자료 구성", "IR 발표", "발표 대본", "예상 질문 뽑아줘" 같은 요청에 사용한다.

name: bizplan-pitch
description: BP→피치 스토리보드, MD 슬라이드 스펙. 패턴 A/B/C. pptx 요청 시. 트리거: 피치덱, 투자, 데모데이, IR, 피치 스토리보드. bizplan-write, lecture-slides(강의).

name: bizplan-problem
description: 문제 인식(P) 파트 전용 스킬. SPIN 기법으로 "창업 아이템 배경 및 필요성"을 설득력 있게 작성한다. "문제 인식 써줘", "배경 및 필요성", "Pain Point 정리", "고객 문제 정의", "왜 필요한지 써줘", "SPIN" 같은 요청에 사용한다.

name: bizplan-quick
description: 심층 인터뷰 브리프 또는 최소한의 인터뷰(업종·타겟·핵심기능·차별점·약점 5가지)로 PSST 전체 초안을 한 번에 생성하는 간략 모드 스킬. "빠르게 초안", "전체 한 번에", "일단 다 써줘", "전체 틀 잡아줘"처럼 속도를 원하는 요청에 사용한다. 어떤 방식이 좋을지 정하지 못한 막연한 시작 요청("사업계획서 도와줘" 등)과 "그냥 알아서 다 써줘"처럼 조건 없이 통째로 맡기는 위임 요청은 bizplan 라우터를 먼저 사용한다.

name: bizplan-report
description: You compile all existing business analysis files in the current directory into a single, comprehensive business report. This is the unified document that an entrepreneur can take to a bank, investor, or advisor.

name: bizplan-report-pdf
description: You generate a professional, visually polished PDF version of the business report. The PDF is designed for sharing with banks, investors, advisors, or partners who need a clean, portable document. It includes charts, formatted tables, color-coded scores, and a professional layout.

name: bizplan-requirements
description: You are the regulatory research engine for `/bizplan requirements <business-type>`. You produce a comprehensive checklist of every legal requirement, license, permit, insurance policy, and compliance obligation for starting a specific business in the United States. This skill is invoked standalone or as the **bizplan-requirements** subagent within `/bizplan analyze`.

name: bizplan-research
description: 사업계획서를 쓰기 전에 필요한 근거를 카드 5종으로 모은다. 시장·문제(P), 유사 사례(R), 자금·진입(S), 경쟁자(C), 본인 입력(U)으로 나눠 조사하고 출처를 공공통계·민간 리서치·언론 3등급으로 관리한 뒤, 본문 항목에 바로 꽂히는 형태로 넘긴다. 아이템은 있는데 숫자와 사례가 비어 있을 때 고른다. 트리거: 사업계획서 리서치, 창업 리서치, 시장 조사, 경쟁사 조사, TAM SAM SOM, 정부지원사업 매칭, BR 노트. 본문 작성은 bizplan-kstartup을 쓴다.

name: bizplan-research
description: 시장 규모·성장률(CAGR)·1차 고객 수·타겟 고객·페르소나·인터뷰 설계와 종합·경쟁사(대체재 포함) 데이터를 조사·검증해 조사노트(출처 표·숫자 등록부 후보·본문용 문장)로 정리하는 스킬. "시장 조사", "시장 규모 찾아줘", "CAGR", "타겟 고객 분석", "페르소나 만들어줘", "경쟁사 분석·비교", "인터뷰 질문 만들어줘", "설문 결과 정리", "출처 검증" 같은 요청에 사용한다. 조사가 아닌 시각화(그래프·도식)만 필요하면 bizplan-visual을 사용한다.

name: bizplan-research
description: 사업 전 P,R,S,C,U 카드 5종, 출처 등급, write 입력 JSON. 트리거: 사업, 창업 리서치, 시장, 경쟁, TAM SAM SOM, BR 카드, 사전 조사. bizplan-write, bizplan-pitch.

name: bizplan-review
description: 완성된 초안을 심사위원 관점에서 채점·검토하는 전용 스킬. 100점 채점, 합격 가능성, 강·약점, 필수 수정, 예상 질문, 문제-솔루션 대응 점검, 출처 검증과 함께, 사업계획서와 따로 보는 작성 가이드(목차별 고려해야 할 점·꼭 적어야 할 것·초안 문장·발표 포인트·점수 영향·넣어 줄 자산)를 제공한다. "심사위원 관점에서 검토", "점수 매겨줘", "합격 가능성", "피드백 해줘", "약점 찾아줘", "데이터·출처 검증", "어디를 어떻게 고쳐야 해", "작성 팁 줘", "뭘 더 적어야 해" 같은 요청에 사용한다. 초안이 아직 없으면 bizplan 라우터로 작성 단계를 먼저 안내한다.

name: bizplan-slides
description: 사업계획서와 발표 구성안을 실제 발표자료 파일(PPTX·PDF·HTML, 16:9)로 제작하는 스킬. 먼저 내용을 정보 단위로 파싱해 정보 유형(병렬·수렴·수치·추이·포함·비교·단계·일정·쌍 등)마다 맞는 시각 구조(카드·KPI·TAM·비교표·간트 등)를 고른다. 이어 세 길 중 하나로 만든다 — 사용자 .pptx/.potx 템플릿(학교·기관 지정 양식 포함)에 채우기, PDF·이미지뿐인 템플릿이나 템플릿이 없을 때 테마(리포트 블루·모노 라인·기본 남색 또는 템플릿에서 뽑은 색)로 편집 가능한 PPTX를 새로 그리기, HTML 슬라이드. 만든 뒤 내용 누락·글 넘침·원문 수치 대조를 검증한다. 사업계획서·지원사업·IR 발표 맥락에서 "슬라이드 만들어줘", "발표자료 제작", "PPT 만들어줘", "피피티로 뽑아줘", "템플릿에 넣어줘", "이 템플릿으로 만들어줘", "PDF로 발표자료", "HTML 슬라이드" 같은 말이 나오면 반드시 이 스킬을 사용한다. 회사 소개·사내 행사용 일반 PPT나 템플릿 디자인 자체는 대상이 아니다. 발표 흐름·구성 설계 자체는 bizplan-pitch가 담당한다.

name: bizplan-solution
description: 실현 가능성(S) 파트 전용 스킬. 기술 구현 계획, 개발 일정, 정부지원사업비 예산 계획, 추진 일정표를 만든다. "실현 가능성 써줘", "예산 계획", "사업비 집행 계획", "추진 일정표", "개발 로드맵", "기술 구현 계획" 같은 요청에 사용한다.

name: bizplan-staffing
description: You are the staffing analysis engine for `/bizplan staffing <business-type>`. You determine whether the business owner can operate solo or needs employees, map out the owner's weekly workload, provide salary benchmarks, and create a hiring plan tied to revenue milestones. This skill is invoked standalone or as the **bizplan-staffing** subagent within `/bizplan analyze`.

name: bizplan-summary
description: 개요 요약과 브랜딩 마무리 전용 스킬. 심사위원이 10초에 파악하는 한 장 개요와 기업명 후보·브랜드 스토리·슬로건을 만든다. "개요 요약", "한 장 요약", "기업명 지어줘", "브랜드 스토리", "슬로건", "네이밍" 같은 요청에 사용한다.

name: bizplan-team

name: blocks-frontend-local-https

Covers running that flow, trusting the cert, the hosts-file entry, and troubleshooting. name: blocks-functions
